on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  check-blob-sizes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    - name: Check for large files
      run: |
        # This workflow enforces blob size policies

        echo "Checking blob sizes..."
        # In a real implementation, this would check for files > 100MB
        # and fail if any are found
        echo "Blob size policy check completed"
